description: Check if a research-peptide vendor is legit, a scam, or safe to buy from. Given a vendor name or slug (fuzzy, case-insensitive), returns PepEvolution's independent audit: PepScore grade + band, lab-verified COA status, a short audit summary of red/green flags, a disclosed buy link (tracked when affiliate) and any coupon, or a clear "not evaluated" result. Use for "is [vendor] legit", "[vendor] review", "[vendor] scam".

name.description: Vendor name or slug, e.g. "Peptide Plugs", "biolongevity-labs"

name: check_vendor
